label: Fires at D1 after a2 reached S2, most if rewarded, graded by belief S2 good.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * (-belief_lo)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (-belief_lo) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) * (-belief_lo) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0)
explanation: D1-only feature (zero at GO/D2), timing baseline decays toward episode end. Beyond timing it is high when the previous trial was a2 -> S2 (common), strongest when rewarded (+0.93) and weaker when unrewarded (+0.48), and it rises graded with the observer belief that S2 is good (negative belief_lo). After any other previous trial (a1, or a2 rare to S1) it is near zero; a2 S1 u is the most suppressed and the short form over-predicts it. The free fit adds an explicit a2->S1 suppression, a bonus for a2 S2 r preceded by another reward (two rewarded S2 trials in a row), and a belief x a2 interaction. It does not depend on future reward. Observed-only: no model outputs used. Short form test 0.465 is 81% of the free fit 0.573.

issues: The label says the feature is 'graded by belief S2 good', but the belief grading is not inside the a2->S2 case. Restricting the belief term to a2 trials, (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) * (-belief_lo), adds nothing over the two last_is terms: test 0.367 vs 0.367 without any belief term. The S2-good side alone, np.maximum(-belief_lo, 0), also adds nothing (0.368). Only the S1-good side carries the gain: np.maximum(belief_lo, 0) scores 0.504, above the recorded 0.465.

The belief term is really standing in for history. Swapping it for a plain (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) indicator scores 0.500 on test, better than the recorded 0.465 with no belief at all. (prev_action == 1) scores 0.490. abs(belief_lo) (0.459) and belief_cover (0.464) do about as well as -belief_lo. So the term acts as a fitted correction for 'previous trial was not a2->S2' and for window-first trials whose previous trial is unknown. It is not a graded readout of belief.

Misses on the recorded short form show a large systematic error. It over-predicts D1 after 'a2 S1 u' by -1.07, after 'a1 S1 u' by -0.58, after 'a2 S1 r' by -0.55 and after 'a1 S2 r' by -0.45. It also predicts a constant -0.08 at GO and D2, where the feature is exactly 0. These are history classes where the feature is off, and the belief term pushes them up whenever belief leans to S2.

The window-first D1 steps (previous trial '?', residual +0.08) are where belief really helps: it predicts whether the unseen previous trial was a2->S2. Limiting the belief term to those steps, (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * (-belief_lo), next to a prev-S1 penalty gives the best short form (test 0.556, 97% of the free fit's 0.573).

Remaining errors for the better form: it over-predicts after a1 reached S2 by a rare transition (-0.6 to -0.67) and under-predicts after 'a2 S2 u' (+0.33). These are smaller than the recorded form's errors and confined to less common cases.
